review:2:place-grand-temple.name: Grand Temple
review:2:place-grand-temple.notes: Vaulted nave and cloister bell-tower tending the town archives, ossuary, and healing shrine.
review:2:place-grand-temple.gmNotes: High Prelate withholds burial records from the western crypt unless a tithe or relic is returned.

review:2:place-high-keep.name: High Keep
review:2:place-high-keep.notes: Fortified citadel commanding the town walls, garrison courtyard, and inner dungeon vaults.
review:2:place-high-keep.gmNotes: Watch patrols double at dusk; the under-bailey postern links to the old storm sewers.

review:2:place-market-square.name: Market Square
review:2:place-market-square.notes: Open stone plaza bustling with merchant stalls, town criers, and caravan wagons.
review:2:place-market-square.gmNotes: Hook: Cutpurses work the spice stalls at noon; an alderman seeks escorts for a delayed grain barge.

review:2:place-building-0.name: Inn 1
review:2:place-building-0.notes: Crowded common room with spiced ale, rumor-trading drovers, and warm bunk lofts.
review:2:place-building-0.gmNotes: Proprietor buys odd dungeon salvage and holds locked cellar stairs behind the cask rack.
